Signals are inherited DOWNWARD: the scope is the place's ancestor chain UNION its subtree. A sibling is not an ancestor. Corrected because the value is unambiguous and leaving a spec that yields an empty calendar is worse than editing it. RF2 (OWNER ITEM 31i): the P2 rule matrix rules on NONE of the five signal types present for City/Conference Hotel - step 4 is a no-op for that archetype - and Travel-Trade, which slot P6 classifies as DOMINANT for the sector, appears in no archetype row at all. RF3: 'The Hospitality Show 2026' is T1/Confirmed/Medium with NO Geography, so it is unreachable by every place-scoped resolution regardless of tier. Fix by tagging, not by relaxing the filter. RF4: the Timeliness gate fired live - Shoulder Season's derived Action Deadline was 2026-08-18, ten days before the run. First proof the calendar goes stale silently. RF5 (OWNER ITEM 31h): 'Destination Fit' has two defensible readings, and under the strict one (a Destination Profile must resolve) NO opportunity can pass the gate today in any place, because DB16 is empty and Content DB5's Destination relation was deferred. RF6: P7's Travel-Trade row has no revenue_watch offset; reported unavailable, recorded so it is not later 'fixed' by substitution. ALSO CORRECTED: plugin.config.json claimed '1 DB13 Forecast'; DB13 holds 0 and always did.

payload.escalation: THREE THINGS THE RUN SURFACED. (1) PARTIAL AUTHORITY: src_efrag_esrs backs only HALF the CSRD signal. That row asserts both the revised ESRS timing (EFRAG's own - T1) and the Wave-2 reporting DELAY, which is a European Commission legislative act. A government fact is T1 only from the government, so the delay half remains unbacked until the Commission or EUR-Lex is registered. The generalisable rule, now written into S03: REGISTER THE SOURCE AGAINST THE CLAIM, NOT AGAINST THE ROW - a single signal can carry two claims with two different owners. (2) LEGAL LINE HELD: 23 of 24 sources are Feed Type=HTML, which means a human reads a published page. That is NOT a scrape and no automated extraction is configured; every row says so in its Legal Posture Note. The moment anyone automates extraction against one, its Feed Type becomes `scrape` and it must go to Legal (10) before staying active - the standing owner constraint. (3) NASCIO is authoritative and unreachable, the same shape as the expired .go.ke certificates: authority and reachability are different axes, and conflating them would either fabricate a verification or discard a real authority.
